name: cc-data-anonymizer
description: Maskuje citlivá data (jména Notes, e-maily, hesla, tokeny) v promptech, @ souborech a výsledcích nástrojů přes CLI anon

style.title: Replacement style
style.description: How anon mask replaces values: fake (realistic fake values), redact (REDACTED, cannot be restored), tag («REDACTED:kind:n», restorable). "default" leaves it to anon (rules.toml).

unmaskReply.title: Unmask replies on screen
unmaskReply.description: Show the assistant's replies with the original values (the model still sees fakes).
